name: Arcane Obstruction
body:
School abjuration; Level druid 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 full round
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range 50 ft.
Target 50-ft. radius centered on caster
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Within a 50-foot radius of the caster, the casting time of all arcane spells and spell-like abilities is increased. Quickened spells require a standard action; spells that require a standard action instead require a full-round action; and spells that require 1 full round or more have their casting times doubled.

The globe of energy created by arcane obstruction moves with the caster.
